Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing multiple liquor licenses at the same physical premises.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to allowing multiple liquor licenses at the samephysical premises; and adding a new section to chapter 66.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If a licensee complies with the provisions of RCW 66.28.280,66.28.285, 66.28.290, 66.28.295, 66.28.300, 66.28.305, 66.28.310, and66.28.315, nothing in this title prohibits any number or combination oflicenses or approvals from being issued or approved for the samepremises, overlapping premises, adjacent premises, or separate premisesto the same licensee or to different licensees under common ownership. (2) Nothing in this section prohibits different licensees fromallocating distinct parts of a single business location to theirseparate licenses.
